title: deployctl rollout --dry-run
context: Repo: deployctl, the internal CLI on-call uses to roll services across host fleets. CI builds a static binary from main in a clean checkout and distributes it to on-call laptops. The dry-run feature exists so on-call can trust the printed batch plan before running the real rollout.

defects.description: go.mod adds a replace directive to a sibling path ../zap that exists only on the author's machine; CI's clean checkout of main cannot build, and any machine that has that path builds an unreviewed local fork into the on-call binary.

printPlan reimplements batch splitting instead of calling computeBatches, and the copy already diverges (floor vs ceil, canary host not removed from the remaining hosts), so the dry-run plan differs from what Run executes and will keep drifting.

decoys: Dry-run cannot mutate anything: it returns after the read-only Hosts() call and before any deployBatch.
